derived_house_rule.src: KCIL rotation lock section 16.10, KP MAX FAM and MAR cards
derived_house_rule.text: For a relative, rotate first. The relative becomes the Lagna and his or her own houses are counted from it. The house n of a relative whose own house is R is the house R plus n minus 1, counted in the native chart with wrap at 12. Standing rotations spouse 7, mother 4, father 9, first child 5, second child 7, third child 9 and 2 more each after, elder co born 11, younger co born 3. Spouse profession is the spouse 10th, which is the native 4th. Spouse 6th is the native 12th, spouse 8th is the native 2nd, spouse 7th is the native Lagna. Father 10th is the native 6th. Mother 10th is the native 1st.
